{"metadata":{"description":"Real-time chain-of-thought anchoring monitor & intervention plugin for DeepSeek Harness: three-band (spec/mixed/react) fingerprint detection, L1 hint / L2 reset / L3 restart interventions, liquid-glass web overlay + rheostat bar, standalone monitor process with JSONL experiment l","id":"gh:1337467566","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-anchored-monitor","slug":"Aik358/dsh-anchored-monitor","topics":["anchoring","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","monitoring","reasoning"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Real-time chain-of-thought anchoring monitor & intervention plugin for DeepSeek Harness: three-band "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"(spec/mixed/react) fingerprint detection, L1 hint / L2 reset / L3 restart interventions, liquid-glas"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"s web overlay + rheostat bar, standalone monitor process with JSONL experiment l"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-anchored-monitor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **In one sentence (一句话说清): it's a whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro.**
> When the model falls from the focu"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"sed, high-capability mode
> ("We need…" / "I will…") into the scattered, low-focus mode ("let me…"),"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"
> the whip cracks — and pulls it back.

> 跌落到「let me」的发散、低专注、低效率模式时，就抽它一鞭，让它改回去。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Real-time chain-of-thought anchoring monitor & intervention for DeepSeek Harness.
> Watch the we /"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" let's / let me fingerprint of every reasoning block, stay in the
> spec band, and pull the model ba"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ck automatically when the trajectory drifts."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it is, in one line"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Don't touch a thing and it's simply a live gauge of how hard your model is
thinking right now.** T"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"hinking intensity, three-band state and the ECG-style
curve, tucked into the corner of your screen —"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" a real-time visualization of
your model's thinking efficiency / capability intensity."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Visualization first (default — no intervention until you want it)**: a
real-time thinking-effici"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ency / capability-intensity gauge.
- **Intervention when you need the whip**: only cracks when the t"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"rajectory
drifts into the scattered "let me" band — and it auto-continues the task.
- **「滑动变祖器」meme "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"skin**: flip the gauge into a Liang-o-meter that
live-queries DeepSeek V4 Pro's *"梁系强度"* (from focus"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ed-humble to
emperor-slacking) while it runs."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> Open the settings page and you can tune every parameter — and one-click
> **Reset to defaults** if"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" you ever change too much."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Which mode does it pair with?"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**You don't need to force-install dsh-anchored-standard.**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The monitor never checks a preset's *name*. It reads every session's reasoning
blocks (`~/.dsh/sessi"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ons/*/events.jsonl`) and scores them purely by the
`we / let's / let me` fingerprint (spec band < 0."},{"id":"p12s3","text":"2, mixed 0.2–0.5, react ≥ 0.5).
So **any preset that implements the anchored-standard discipline** —"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" anchor the
first turn with the Minimal persona (46-character persona + `bash`/`str_replace_editor`)"},{"id":"p12s5","text":",
then plan in a collective "we" style without "let me" — pairs with this plugin.
Renamed / derivati"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ve presets work too: **梁神模式 (Liang-god Mode)**, liangshen,
and any other preset built on the same an"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"choring idea. The L2 reset payload is
fully self-contained (the Minimal 46-character persona + the d"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ual tools ship in
this plugin's own config), so nothing is imported from another repo at runtime."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> ⚠️ One caveat: if the session was never anchored in the first place, it stays
> in the react band "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"and L2 keeps firing — that's a fight loop, not monitoring.
> Keep interventions **OFF (monitor-only)"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"** unless you're on the model this whip
> was tuned for."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"DeepSeek V4 Pro conditions heavily on what the **first request** shows it. The
community measured th"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"e consequence: the official Minimal preset (46-character
persona + `bash`/`str_replace_editor`) anch"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ors a collective "we" trajectory
and scores 99/96 on Project2, while the full Standard preset anchor"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"s an
actor-style "let me" trajectory and scores 91. Behavior is **path-committed**:
once anchored, e"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"xpanding the tool catalog perturbs at most one reasoning block —
the mode never flips back on its ow"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"anding the tool catalog perturbs at most one reasoning block —
the mode never flips back on its own."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Anchored presets (dsh-anchored-standard)
solve the *bootstrap*. This plugin solves what happens **af"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ter** anchoring:
external factors (imperative hints, oversized injected context) can drag the
trajec"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"tory out of the spec band, and nothing detects or repairs that drift —
until now."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Live fingerprinting** — every reasoning block is scored for the spec
trajectory markers (`we`, `"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"let's`, `we'll`, `we need`, …) versus the
react marker (`let me`), over a sliding window.
- **Three-"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"band model** — exactly the quantization measured by
dsh-router-standard:
`persona_ratio < 0.2 → spec"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"`, `0.2–0.5 → mixed` (the unstable transition
band), `≥ 0.5 → react`.
- **Tiered intervention** — au"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"tomatic, cooldown-gated, with hysteresis recovery:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Level | Trigger | Action |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| L1 hint | entering the mixed band | injects a **suggestive** hint (never imperative — commands fli"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"p we→let me) |
| L2 reset | entering the react band | next request gets the 46-char Minimal persona "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"+ `bash`/`str_replace_editor` only; monitor window/baseline reset |
| L3 restart | L2 retries exhaus"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ted | recommends restarting the session |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Liquid-glass Web UI** — a sidebar entry opens a frosted-glass panel floating
above the conversat"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ion (drag / resize / remembered). Collapsed, it becomes a
**rheostat-style bar** showing thinking in"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"tensity as a slider position plus a
rolling log ticker. DeepSeek white/gray/blue palette; dark mode "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"uses neutral
grays matching the shell. The bar is a fixed-width rounded rectangle (320px,
viewport-a"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"daptive) — no size jumping. **zh/en language toggle** in the panel
header and settings.
- **Two skin"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"s** — the default **Serious** rheostat bar, or the **Meme** skin
("滑动变祖器 / Liang-o-meter"): a 52px s"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"peech-bubble floats **above the
intensity knob** and slides with it, flipping through Liang Wenfeng "},{"id":"p22s8","text":"faces —
from *focused* (humble) to *slacking* (emperor) — as thinking intensity
rises, pulsing with "},{"id":"p22s9","text":"the band color. The face images are **embedded in the
client bundle** (base64) so they always load. "},{"id":"p22s10","text":"Switch in the settings page
(saved locally). Face assets from
Lichtspektrum/liang-intensity-calibrat"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"or
(MIT).
